name: GHGSat reviewed-null prior-reference catalog audit
research_question: Do the 79 frozen GHGSat target source-sensor pairs yield enough prediction-blind prior same-granule references to support at least 28 distinct locally observable reviewed-null training observations?

decision_context_disclosed_before_freeze.outcome_blindness: No reference catalog, target or reference asset URL, raster window, local observability result, model artifact, MARS development outcome, or official benchmark outcome has been accessed for this source before freeze.

source_pair_contract.label_boundary: The source is a reviewed site-level GHGSat non-detection above applicable sensitivity, not physical zero and not a dense all-negative scene. Reference selection cannot strengthen that label.

sentinel_2_l1c.same_granule_rule: MGRS tile parsed from the frozen target item ID must match exactly.

landsat_8_9_level_1.same_granule_rule: Six-digit WRS path/row parsed from the frozen target item ID must match exactly.

reference_contract.point_coverage: Full candidate geometry contains or touches the exact frozen source point.
reference_contract.excluded_items: Every frozen target item ID for the same target sensor, globally across the 79 rows.

query_contract.geometry: Exact WGS84 Point at the frozen representative longitude/latitude.
query_contract.fields_extension: Request only structural and required item metadata; exclude assets and links.
query_contract.checkpointing: Append-only exact request and accepted-response hash receipts under the ignored root; resume only on canonical request, endpoint, source identity, target identity, and accepted parsed-candidate checkpoint match.

failure_action: Retire GHGSat as the missing-negative pairing source without widening either reference window, raising the cloud ceiling, accepting future references, accepting a different product level/tier, relaxing same-granule matching, or pooling another failed source.
pass_action: Commit the exact target/reference item manifest, then freeze a separate sensor-specific asset-resolution and windowed-raster/local-observability protocol before requesting any asset URL or raster byte.

permitted: metadata-only POST responses from the two exact frozen STAC search endpoints
HTTP headers and retry metadata required to validate those responses
forbidden: any target or reference asset URL
any raster, preview, thumbnail, QA band, metadata asset, or full product
any model artifact, prediction, score, threshold, protected fold outcome, or official benchmark outcome
any location coordinate as a model feature

claim_boundary: A PASS establishes deterministic prior-reference catalog feasibility only. It does not establish asset accessibility, local cloud/radiometric observability, a dense no-plume mask, training value, calibration, generalization, or superiority over MARS-S2L.
